svg.text: Combined ablation matrix: per-plane runtime health
19 configurations x 6 health planes. Cell = plane health in [0,1]; row mean = runtime integrity score (RIS). Detection is normalised by the baseline rate (0.481).
"n/a" = the metric is undefined because the ablation destroyed that plane. It is scored as 0
(destroyed) when averaging into the RIS, and never imputed.
